# Grading fixtures

`handmade.rul` is a grade rule table written by hand from the public description of the
AAMA/ASTM `.RUL` layout (S. Bakker, *ePattern ASTM Standard*, DH Patterns and Fit, the
"Grading" section), independently of FashionCraft's writer. It covers values split over
lines, tabs and commas without spaces as separators, a lower-case `rule:delta`, a negative
rule number, and a rule whose sample size is not zero (read as measured from the sample).
